MOLECULAR PATHOLOGY REPORT
[redacted location] Cancer Center

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Age/Sex: 45 year old Male
Ordering Physician: Dr. [redacted name]
Specimen Type: EBUS-guided lymph node biopsy
Specimen Site: Station 4R and 7 mediastinal lymph nodes
Collection Date: [redacted date]
Received Date: [redacted date]
Report Date: [redacted date]

CLINICAL HISTORY
Recent pulmonary embolism. Lung mass with mediastinal lymphadenopathy. EBUS-guided biopsy revealed bulky station 4R (2.3 cm) and station 7 (7.76 cm) nodes. Suspected non-small cell lung carcinoma.

SPECIMEN ADEQUACY
Estimated tumor content: 70%
Specimen adequate for molecular analysis

SUMMARY OF RESULTS
• KRAS mutation detected: c.34G>T, p.(Gly12Cys) at 31% allele frequency
• ALK rearrangement: NEGATIVE (FISH)
• ROS1 rearrangement: NEGATIVE (FISH)
• EGFR mutations: NOT DETECTED
• NRAS mutations: NOT DETECTED
• BRAF mutations: NOT DETECTED

FLUORESCENCE IN SITU HYBRIDIZATION (FISH) ANALYSIS

ALK Gene Rearrangement Analysis
Probe: Vysis ALK Break Apart FISH Probe Kit
Result: NEGATIVE for ALK rearrangement
Interpretation: No evidence of ALK gene rearrangement. 2-3 copies of intact ALK observed per cell.
Cells analyzed: 50 interphase nuclei
Positive cells: 2/50 (4%)
Cutoff for positive: ≥15%

ROS1 Gene Rearrangement Analysis
Probe: Vysis ROS1 Break Apart FISH Probe Kit
Result: NEGATIVE for ROS1 rearrangement
Interpretation: No evidence of ROS1 gene rearrangement
Cells analyzed: 50 interphase nuclei
Positive cells: 1/50 (2%)
Cutoff for positive: ≥15%

MOLECULAR ANALYSIS - TARGETED NEXT-GENERATION SEQUENCING

Methodology: DNA extracted from FFPE tissue. Library preparation using targeted amplicon-based approach. Sequencing performed on benchtop next-generation sequencer with minimum coverage of 500x. Analysis includes:
• EGFR exons 18-21
• KRAS codons 12, 13, 61
• NRAS codons 12, 13, 59, 61, 146
• BRAF codon 600

DETAILED MOLECULAR RESULTS

KRAS (NM_033360.3)
Variant detected: c.34G>T, p.(Gly12Cys)
Allele frequency: 31%
Coverage at position: 1,245x
Classification: Pathogenic
COSMIC ID: COSM516

EGFR (NM_005228.5)
Exons 18-21: No mutations detected
Mean coverage: 892x
Deletions/insertions: None detected

NRAS (NM_002524.5)
Codons analyzed: 12, 13, 59, 61, 146
Result: No mutations detected
Mean coverage: 756x

BRAF (NM_004333.6)
Codon 600: Wild type
Mean coverage: 1,023x

CLINICAL INTERPRETATION
The KRAS G12C mutation detected is an activating mutation commonly found in non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC). This mutation is associated with:
• Decreased sensitivity to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors
• Potential eligibility for KRAS G12C-specific inhibitors (e.g., sotorasib, adagrasib)

The absence of ALK and ROS1 rearrangements indicates this patient is unlikely to benefit from ALK or ROS1 tyrosine kinase inhibitors.

The absence of EGFR mutations suggests this tumor would not respond to first-line EGFR TKI therapy.

Electronically signed by:
[redacted name], MD, PhD
Board Certified in Molecular Genetic Pathology
